title: Remove all music-related features and code

requirements.text: Remove all music-related backend state and functions from backend/main.mo: delete song favorites storage, all song favorites query/update/delete methods, and any music-specific types or imports. Keep user profile management and URL favorites intact.
acceptanceCriteria: backend/main.mo contains no song favorites stable variables
backend/main.mo contains no addSongFavorite, removeSongFavorite, getSongFavorites, or equivalent methods
User profile and URL favorites functionality is unaffected

requirements.text: Delete or fully gut all music-related frontend pages: Music.tsx, Playlists.tsx, PlaylistDetail.tsx, Favorites.tsx (song-favorites version), AlbumDetail.tsx, ArtistDetail.tsx. Replace any removed pages with a simple placeholder or redirect so the router does not break.
acceptanceCriteria: No music, playlists, album, or artist detail pages are accessible
App router does not throw errors for removed routes
Navigation links to removed pages are removed from Layout.tsx and Home.tsx

requirements.text: Remove all music-related components: MusicPlayer.tsx, SongCard.tsx, TrackCard.tsx, AddToPlaylistModal.tsx, and MusicTickerWidget.tsx. Remove MusicPlayerProvider and MusicPlayerContext.tsx. Remove any persistent MusicPlayer rendered in App.tsx.
acceptanceCriteria: MusicPlayer component is no longer rendered anywhere in the app
No SongCard, TrackCard, or AddToPlaylistModal components exist
MusicPlayerContext and MusicPlayerProvider are deleted
App.tsx does not import or render any music player or music context

requirements.text: Delete all music-related services and hooks: musicApiService.ts, spotifyService.ts, youtubeService.ts, soundcloudService.ts, useMusicSearch.ts, usePlaylists.ts, useSongFavorites.ts, and the music-related parts of useQueries.ts (song favorites queries/mutations).
acceptanceCriteria: No Spotify, YouTube, or SoundCloud service files exist
No musicApiService.ts exists
useMusicSearch, usePlaylists, useSongFavorites hooks are deleted
useQueries.ts retains only non-music favorites logic, with all song favorites hooks removed

requirements.text: Delete all music-related data files: music.ts, generatedMusic.ts, fallbackMusic.ts. Delete frontend/src/types/music.ts (Song, Playlist interfaces).
acceptanceCriteria: No music.ts, generatedMusic.ts, or fallbackMusic.ts data files exist
frontend/src/types/music.ts is deleted
No TypeScript errors from missing music type imports remain

requirements.text: Update App.tsx to remove all music-related route definitions (music, playlists, playlist detail, artist detail, album detail), remove MusicPlayerProvider wrapper, and remove the persistent MusicPlayer component. Update Layout.tsx to remove navigation links to music pages. Update Home.tsx to remove the Music section navigation card.
acceptanceCriteria: App.tsx has no music, playlist, artist, or album routes
Layout.tsx navigation contains no music-related links
Home.tsx hero/nav cards contain no Music section link
App compiles and runs without errors

constraints: Do not remove Games, Movies, Anime, K-Drama, J-Drama, C-Drama, or any non-music features
Do not edit files listed in frontend.immutablePaths
Keep user profile management and URL favorites in the backend intact
Do not break the overall app routing or layout
nonGoals: Adding any new features or pages
Removing movie or TV show integrations
